notes.title: Shredders FSR 3.1 Update
notes.content:
Hello shredders,

We hope you are all enjoying Glacier 🧊 and Shredding it to pieces.

We are super happy to announce that this new update brings AMD FSR3.1 to Shredders across all platforms.

This allows the game to run at roughly 25% higher frame rates with the same quality settings, especially on resolutions above 1080p, up to 4k. You can activate FSR 3.1 in the game options.

This update also contains a few bug fixes reported by the community in the last weeks.

Enjoy and have fun on the slopes,

The Shredders team

notes.title: Shredders’ Glacier update
notes.content:
Glacier — You Are Welcome!

It’s almost winter again, the most wonderful time of the year for us Shredders. It’s getting cold outside, nothing better than a good old session of Shredders with your friends to keep you warm… or not! Because we made the coldest, most insane Uber cool new zone: Glacier!

It has one of the longest top-to-bottom flow lines in Shredders, and one of the hardest-hitting, air-time, and versatile parks we have ever created. We poured our frozen hearts into it, and all we can say now is go enjoy it, pull your best moves, chill with your friends, land some massive tricks, and have fun! 

[previewyoutube=v51W7CHU8aA;full][/previewyoutube]
Massive new zone: Glacier

Glacier is huge! One of the largest additions to Shredders yet, whether you like big natural kickers, groomed zones, or back-to-back park features, we’ve got you covered. It also comes with not just one new half-pipe, but two!
8 new missions showcasing the new zone and allowing you to unlock new pro gear for this season.
17 new hotspots through the Glacier area. 8 lines score, 2 rail contests, 3 best tricks, and 4 new time attacks!

notes.title: 540INDY Invitational
notes.content:
After the success of the first edition, we’re thrilled to announce the return of the 540INDY Invitational—the ultimate virtual snowboarding contest. Get ready for bigger air, gnarlier tricks, and even more stoke!


[previewyoutube=GHYTH7YCAJo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Shredders 2024 Expansion
notes.content:
Crater Park — You Are Welcome!

The highly anticipated Crater Park is finally open. Playful, challenging, gigantic—it’s the biggest park we’ve ever built, and it’s free. As a thank you for all the love and support from our community. 🩵💚❤️🩷🧡 In addition to endless fun and exploration, Crater Park comes with 8 new missions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/fe2bee5b1bb19eda4769fcbaf80a95c5f0827b7b.png

The North Face MTN MIX Basecamp

We teamed up with pioneering outdoor brand The North Face to bring you a little piece of chill and coziness called The North Face MTN MIX Basecamp. 🔥 It’s an awesome spot to ride or to relax after hitting Shred’s Gap, our tribute to the iconic Chad’s Gap.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/98a1547a31b072df6908a60e1fca834edbb811df.png

540INDY Slopestyle 2024

We’re thrilled to announce the return of the 540INDY Invitational—Shredders’ official in-game snowboarding contest. For this year’s venue, we switched up the course design with a hybrid concept that showcases as many aspects of snowboarding as possible in one course.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/5823b7be2b2b10febbc59532a1a4b988ce7bce87.png

A touch of swag…

As a little extra, we included two new Nitro snowboards—the 2025 signature models of Shredders’ heroes Marcus Kleveland and Elias Elhardt. Join them in new missions to unlock the boards. The brand-new 540INDY hoodies also made it to the game.

…and a lot more love

New Features

Hotspots: new time attack lines
New builder items—natural & Crater related
New graphics options added (PC only)

Enhancements

Improved performance
Maple Acres optimization
Replay editor improvements
Menu navigation improvements
Improved streaming handling to prevent object popping
Increased default hotspot speed limit and tweaked specific ones
Spawning in a session now keeps your stance
Spawn points now display in alphabetical order on the map
Improved Method hand animation
Custom spawn is now saved with location and custom sun setting

Bug Fixes

Achievements progression fixes
Mission progression fixes
Fixed control issue when riding out of slippery surface
Lighting issues fix
Maple Acres mission fixes
Prevent gamepad rumble during loadings
Replay editor fixes
Fixed MethodA tutorial/hints not converting to Goofy correctly
Various bug fixes

The season isn’t over yet. Catch you on the slopes! 🤘

notes.title: Shredders Season 23/24 Update
notes.content:
Maple Acres is open now

Maple Acres 🍁 is the latest and greatest addition to the world of Shredders. Our park designers have transformed this timber town into an epic snowboarder’s paradise. Whether you’re an experienced Shredder or new to the game, there’s something here for everyone.
Including 7 new missions to discover the new area and some of its best lines.

Introducing the new 540INDY Collection DLC

Unleash your style on the slopes with this 540INDY DLC expansion featuring top-notch outerwear and high-performance snowboards. Available now, only in Shredders! 🏂✨
You can purchase individual items, or packs combining all outfits, all boards, or the whole collection. (Only exception is the Exclusive 540INDY Invitational 2023 Board, which is awarded to all finalists of last season’s contest.)

Gravity, you said?

The most requested feature by our lovely community is now in the game: the option to modify gravity and jump height in freeride mode! ❤️‍🔥

Shredders just gets better

Scoring calculations are improved.
The fog has been replaced by beautiful real-time clouds.
Main menu flow has been simplified.
Improved Character Editor.
As always: tons of performance optimization and bug fixes.

Here's to a kick-ass season, and there’s more in the making.
Stay tuned and see you on the slopes! 🤘

notes.title: 540INDY Invitational
notes.content:
540INDY Invitational is Shredders’ official in-game snowboarding event, open to all! Ride your steeziest line through the all-new 540INDY Slopestyle course and take home awesome prizes, R-E-S-P-E-C-T, and the title of 540INDY King.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/7b87ce8f80e565f2244d335b7a31df6e117d0246.jpg

The event will be broadcast online on April 29 and you have a chance to be invited! Just send us a recording of your most stylish & creative run on the 540INDY Slopestyle course. A panel of experts will decide who will be invited to the finals, where you will compete live in front of a top-tier jury of pro snowboarders.

 Film a top-to-bottom run on the 540INDY Slopestyle course. Real-time gameplay, no replay. No cuts, no reshreds, just one continuous run.
 Ride the 540INDY Slopestyle as is. No custom features.
 When recording, hide the HUD (in Settings). The game’s scoring system is not taken into account for selection.
 For PC Shredders: no mods allowed, sorry.
 Video specs: 1080p Full HD min 30fps H.264 MP4
 One entry per person.
 PRO TIP: In the finals, you only have a few attempts to put down your best run. It is advisable to focus on lines you can reproduce with confidence rather than trying tricks you only land once in a million times. It's all about creativity, style, and flow!


To enter go to shreddersgame.com/invitational. Be sure to submit your clip by midnight PST on March 9!

notes.title: Shredders Season 2023 Update
notes.content:
Massive new park

 Peak Park is a brand new epic snow park waiting for you up in the high mountains of Gnarnia. We’ve got more rails, secret paths, and giant drops than you could ever have hoped for! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/642544390e7347cab05f44ca4f1c7f39feec0f68.gif

 Eight brand new missions to test you out against the Shredders pro-riders

Huge multiplayer update

 With this update you’ll see more riders on the mountain as we’ve been able to increase public sessions from 6 riders to 10.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/8d7edfa7a0b93772058ecb1dc842b77ed5eae5cb.gif

 Competition time! Take on a new online contest every five minutes to test your Shredders skills with other online players.
 Room codes allow you to easily set up a private mountain between you and others - no matter the platform you’re playing on! PC vs console vs cloud, let’s go!
 You can now add your own park features in private sessions, including kickers, rails and winches - make the mountain yours!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/9701bce826c6b4ac12966dc80f4f706761ee40c4.gif

 Updated the multiplayer menu to help explore the mountain with friends, joining hotspots
 Teleport and follow other players while in drone mode, great way to chill out and watch some epic shredding

New moves

 We’ve added double handed grabs, the epic “Bloody Dracula” and “Rocket Air” moves!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/b4d2defc8ce00861d60402cf089c2441d140ad73.gif

 Master a new variant for the debatably best trick - the Methoda - a take on the classic Method but with way more steeze.
 Walls were always great, but now you can RIDE them.
 Tweaks to the scoring mechanism for better handling of rails and combos

Enhanced replay editor

 You can now record multiple riders in the same replay - so get your buds together and show us what you’ve got!
 Record your best moves in slow motion (or.. fails!)

Plenty of love under the hood

 Plenty of bug fixes
 Performance optimization, Shredders is purring better than ever before
 We’ve gone through every snowflake, snowmobile, and snowboard to make sure they sound extra snowy.

notes.title: Shredders 1.30 Patch
notes.content:

The team is back from some snow-white powder time with some patches and fixes:


 In the replay editor it is now easier to make static camera points that don’t follow your rider.
 The replay editor now allows you to save the field of view (FOV) per camera point and blend between them.
 You can now set the camera to a first-person view in the replay editor! Enjoy those high adrenalin replays.
 New settings added! Audio controls for voices and sound effects, invert the drone Y-axis, and limit frame rate.
 Destroyable 540INDY banners! Smash even more of those pesky (yet delightful) promotional flags.
 More colliders in Petrov! Wallriders and tree-huggers, this one’s for you.
 Updated trick descriptions, glyph position, and other localization issues.

 Fixes for the ‘Knee High’, ‘Mind the Gap’, and ‘Mind (all) the Gaps’ achievements.
 Subtitle fixes for some cutscenes.
 Lighting fixes for the ‘We Own the Sky’ mission.
 Other bug fixes and tweaks.

We hope to see you on the slopes very soon. Enjoy the game!
